'''Muang''' is an independent system in the Core Systems, reached by Commanders pursuing '''[[Broo Tarquin]]''''s laser-weapon Engineering after a referral from [[Hera Tani]]. It hosts '''[[Broo's Legacy]]''', Broo's workshop.<ref name="inara-muang">[https://inara.cz/elite/starsystem/16530/ Muang — Star System], Inara.</ref>

== Overview ==

* '''Star:''' Class K (scoopable)
* '''Allegiance:''' Independent
* '''Government:''' Cooperative
* '''Security:''' High
* '''Economy:''' Extraction / Industrial<ref name="inara-muang" />

== Engineer Facility ==

'''[[Broo's Legacy]]''' is a surface Engineer base on Muang 5 a, operated by '''[[Broo Tarquin]]'''.<ref name="inara-broos-legacy">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/52402/ Broo's Legacy in Muang — Station], Inara.</ref>

No system permit is required to enter Muang. See [[Broo Tarquin]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements for his workshop.
